pyq_focus: Teaching Aptitude se har paper mein lagbhag 5 sawal aate hain (Paper 1 mein total 50 sawal, 10 units).
Sabse zyada: levels of teaching (memory-Herbart, understanding-Morrison, reflective-Hunt) aur unka order.
Evaluation types bahut repeat hote hain: formative vs summative, diagnostic, placement, norm vs criterion referenced.
Methods: teacher-centred vs learner-centred list wale 'select the correct set' sawal; SWAYAM ke quadrants aur SWAYAM Prabha.
Statement type: 'effective teaching ke liye kaunsi practices sahi hain' - hamesha learner-centred, interactive, feedback wale option chuno.
Bloom's taxonomy order (original aur revised) aur domains par match-the-following aate hain.
CBCS grading (O=10, A+=9 ...), CBT aur Computer Adaptive Testing par naye sawal 2019 ke baad aaye hain.
Preparation: tables bana lo (level-thinker, method-father, evaluation-purpose) aur 5 saal ke PYQ zaroor solve karo.

easy.title: Teaching: Concept and Nature
easy.story: Socho mummy tumhe cycle chalana sikha rahi hai. Mummy (teacher), tum (learner) aur ghar ki gali (environment) - teeno milkar teaching banta hai. Teaching ek planned kaam hai jiska goal hai tumhara behaviour badalna. Pehle mummy plan karti hai (pre-active), phir cycle pakadti hai (interactive), phir sochti hai kya galti hui (post-active). Teaching art bhi hai aur science bhi.
easy.trick: Jackson ke 3 phase = 'Pehle Socho, Phir Padhao, Phir Parkho' (Pre-Inter-Post).

easy.title: Objectives of Teaching and Bloom's Taxonomy
easy.story: Teacher ka goal hai bachche ka sir, dil aur haath teeno badalna. Sir = cognitive (jaanna), dil = affective (feel karna), haath = psychomotor (karna). Bloom ne 1956 mein sir wali seedhi banayi: Knowledge se Evaluation tak. 2001 mein Anderson-Krathwohl ne usko verbs mein badla aur sabse upar 'Create' rakha. Jaise pehle recipe yaad karo, phir samjho, phir banao, phir apni nayi dish create karo.
easy.trick: Revised order: 'Ram Usually Applies Apni Extra Creativity' = Remember, Understand, Apply, Analyse, Evaluate, Create.

easy.title: Levels of Teaching: Memory, Understanding and Reflective
easy.story: Teen seedhiyan socho. Pehli seedhi par tum sirf ratta maarte ho, jaise pahada (memory level - Herbart). Doosri par tum samajhte ho ki 2x3=6 kyun hai (understanding level - Morrison). Teesri par tum khud problem solve karte ho, jaise ghar ka budget banana (reflective level - Hunt). Upar jaane ke liye neeche wali seedhi zaroori hai.
easy.trick: 'HMH' = Herbart-Morrison-Hunt, yaani Memory-Understanding-Reflective (Har Mummy Hasti hai).

easy.title: Characteristics and Basic Requirements of Effective Teaching
easy.story: Achha teacher wo hai jo plan karke, pyaar se, bachchon se baat karke padhaye. Wo 'jaane hue se anjaane ki taraf' le jata hai, jaise pehle aam dikhao phir 'fruit' samjhao. Micro-teaching mein teacher chhoti class mein 5-10 minute ek hi skill practice karta hai, jaise cricket nets mein sirf cover drive. Flanders ne class ki baat-cheet ko 10 dibbon mein baanta.

easy.title: Learner's Characteristics: Adolescent and Adult Learners
easy.story: College ke students na bachche hain na pure bade - teenagers aur adults. Teenager ka mood cricket ball jaisa upar-neeche hota hai, isliye Stanley Hall ne isko 'storm and stress' kaha. Wo abstract soch sakte hain (Piaget ka formal operational stage). Adults ko 'kyun seekhna hai' pata hona chahiye, wo apne experience se seekhte hain - isko andragogy kehte hain (Knowles).
easy.trick: Pedagogy = Pede (bachcha), Andragogy = Andra (aadmi), Heutagogy = Heu (khud) - bachcha, bada, khud.

easy.title: Individual Differences and Learning Styles
easy.story: Ek hi class mein koi gaana gaake yaad karta hai, koi likh kar, koi dekh kar. Yahi individual differences hain. Gardner ne kaha intelligence ek nahi, kai prakar ki hai (1983). Fleming ka VARK bolta hai koi Visual, koi Aural, koi Read-write, koi Kinaesthetic learner hai. Teacher ko sabke liye alag tarika apnana chahiye.
easy.trick: Gardner ke 8: 'LLMS BIIN' = Linguistic, Logical, Musical, Spatial, Bodily, Interpersonal, Intrapersonal, Naturalist.

easy.title: Factors Affecting Teaching
easy.story: Teaching ek dish jaisi hai. Achhi dish ke liye cook (teacher), khane wala (learner), masale (support material), kitchen (facilities), mahaul (environment) aur restaurant ka malik (institution) - sab chahiye. Kisi ek ki kami ho to dish kharab. Andar se aane wala motivation (intrinsic) zyada time tak chalta hai.
easy.trick: 6 factors = 'TLS-IEI': Teacher, Learner, Support material, Instructional facility, Environment, Institution.

easy.title: Teacher-Centred vs Learner-Centred Methods
easy.story: Teacher-centred class mein teacher hero hota hai aur bachche audience, jaise lecture. Learner-centred class mein bachche hero hote hain - project, discussion, case study, brainstorming. Kilpatrick ne project method diya, Dewey ke 'learning by doing' se. NET mein learner-centred options zyada sahi maane jaate hain.
easy.trick: Fathers yaad karo: 'Kil-Project, Arm-Heuristic, Park-Dalton, Kel-PSI, Osborn-Brainstorm'.

easy.title: Offline vs Online Methods: SWAYAM, SWAYAM Prabha, MOOCs
easy.story: Pehle padhai sirf class mein hoti thi (offline). Ab mobile par bhi hoti hai (online). SWAYAM sarkar ka free online college hai jisme chaar khane hain: video, padhne ka material, test aur doubt forum. SWAYAM Prabha TV ke free education channels hain. MOOC matlab bahut saare logon ke liye khula online course - shabd 2008 mein bana.
easy.trick: SWAYAM ke 4 quadrants = 'Video, Padho, Test, Charcha' (V-P-T-C); launch date 9 July 2017 dono ki.

easy.title: Teaching Support System: Traditional, Modern and ICT-based
easy.story: Teaching support system ek toolbox hai. Purane tools: blackboard, chart, model (traditional). Naye tools: projector, TV, radio (modern). Sabse naye: computer, smart board, internet, LMS (ICT). Edgar Dale ka cone kehta hai khud karke seekhna sabse pakka hai, sirf sunna sabse kamzor.
easy.trick: Dale's cone: neeche 'Do' (karna), upar 'Words' (shabd) - 'Karo neeche, Bolo upar'.

easy.title: Evaluation: Elements and Types
easy.story: Evaluation matlab sirf number dena nahi, judgement bhi dena. Doctor jaisa socho: pehle check karke ward decide (placement), ilaaj ke beech check (formative), bimari ka karan dhundho (diagnostic), aakhir mein discharge certificate (summative). Achhe test mein validity (sahi cheez naapna) aur reliability (har baar same result) dono chahiye.
easy.trick: Scriven 1967 = 'Form karo beech mein, Sum karo end mein'.

easy.title: Evaluation in Choice Based Credit System (CBCS)
easy.story: CBCS ek buffet jaisa hai - core dish zaroori, baaki elective aur skill wali dish tum chuno. Har course ke credits hote hain aur grade points milte hain. O=10 sabse upar, phir A+=9, A=8 aur aage. SGPA ek semester ka average, CGPA saare semesters ka. NEP 2020 ne Academic Bank of Credits joda.
easy.trick: Grades: 'O A+ A B+ B C P' = 10 9 8 7 6 5 4 - ulti ginti.

easy.title: Computer Based Testing and Innovations in Evaluation
easy.story: Pehle exam OMR sheet par hota tha, ab computer par (CBT). NTA 2018 se NET computer par leta hai. Computer Adaptive Test mein sahi jawab do to agla sawal mushkil, galat do to aasan - jaise video game ke level. Naye tareeke: open book exam, rubrics, online proctoring, e-portfolio.
easy.trick: CAT = 'Cat ki tarah adjust' - jawab ke hisaab se sawal badalta hai.

quotes.quote: Teaching is an intimate contact between a more mature personality and a less mature one which is designed to further the education of the latter.
Teaching is a form of interpersonal influence aimed at changing the behaviour potential of another person.
Teaching is the stimulation, guidance, direction and encouragement of learning.
Teaching refers to activities that are designed and performed to produce change in student behaviour.
Education is not preparation for life; education is life itself.
Formative evaluation is done during the development or improvement of a programme; summative evaluation judges it at the end.
Andragogy is the art and science of helping adults learn.
quotes.source: The Modern Practice of Adult Education, 1970

quotes.quote: What a child can do in co-operation today he can do alone tomorrow.
Evaluation is a systematic process of determining the extent to which educational objectives are achieved by pupils.
Measurement is the quantitative description of pupil behaviour; evaluation adds value judgement to it.
quotes.by: Gronlund (standard formula: Evaluation = Measurement + Value judgement)
